title: Verify that a valid Hero Eyebrow is saved in both languages and rendered on the published page
description: Site Content Editor, record QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch open in Object Authoring. Data: EN 'Economic Research Service', AR 'خدمة البحوث الاقتصادية'.
steps_list: Enter 'Economic Research Service' in the Hero Eyebrow EN field and 'خدمة البحوث الاقتصادية' in the Hero Eyebrow AR field
Publish the record
Open /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research and then /ar/our-services/information/proposal-for-research in a fresh logged-out browser context
expected_list: Both values are accepted with no validation error
The record is saved with status Published and the Liferay generic success toast is displayed
The English hero eyebrow reads 'Economic Research Service' and the Arabic hero eyebrow reads 'خدمة البحوث الاقتصادية', each above its hero title

title: Verify that an empty Hero Eyebrow blocks the save
description: Record open in Object Authoring; Hero Eyebrow EN cleared to an empty string.
steps_list: Clear the Hero Eyebrow EN field so it contains no characters
Attempt to save the record
expected_list: The field is left empty
The save is blocked, the Hero Eyebrow EN field is flagged as required, and the previously published eyebrow value is unchanged on the live page

title: Verify that a whitespace-only Hero Eyebrow blocks the save
description: Record open in Object Authoring; Hero Eyebrow EN set to three space characters '   '.
steps_list: Type three space characters into the Hero Eyebrow EN field so it contains only whitespace
Attempt to save the record
expected_list: The field contains only whitespace
The save is blocked and the Hero Eyebrow EN field is flagged as required — whitespace is not accepted as a value

title: Verify that a Hero Eyebrow of exactly 60 characters is accepted and rendered in full
description: Boundary at the stated max of 60. Data: the character 'A' repeated exactly 60 times.
steps_list: Enter the character 'A' repeated exactly 60 times in the Hero Eyebrow EN field
Publish the record and open the English page in a fresh logged-out browser context
expected_list: The 60-character value is accepted with no validation error and the record saves
The hero eyebrow renders all 60 'A' characters with none truncated

title: Verify that a Hero Eyebrow longer than 60 characters is not accepted
description: Boundary at max+1. Data: the character 'A' repeated 61 times.
steps_list: Attempt to enter the character 'A' repeated 61 times in the Hero Eyebrow EN field
Attempt to save the record
expected_list: The field does not hold 61 characters — input either stops at 60 characters or the value is flagged as exceeding the limit
No value longer than 60 characters is persisted to the record
